name: Barthel Index
description: 10-item scale measuring functional independence in self-care and mobility ADLs. Each item is scored based on observed or reported performance level. Higher score = greater independence.
instructions: Please select the option that best describes your current level of ability for each activity, based on your performance over the past 24–48 hours. Select the highest level you can perform safely and consistently.
shirleySays: ICC 0.95–0.99. MDC: 10 pts. MCID: commonly >10 pts. Normed in stroke, SCI, geriatrics, TBI, MS, hip fracture, cardiac rehab. Known floor effect in severe impairment; ceiling effect in mild cases. Score based on actual performance, not capability.

scoring.formula: sum of all item scores (variable points per item)
scoring.mcidNote: >10-point change commonly accepted as clinically meaningful
